# LOAD PAKAGES
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
local = "__CONFIGURE_PATH_01__"
phylo_dir = paste0(local, "/10_Phylo/01_Porifera_COI")
save_path=paste0(local,"/05_Results_Mantel_Test")
save_path_matrix = paste0(local,"/05_Results_Mantel_Test/01_Matrix")

```


# 0. Leer species_order exportado previamente

```{r}
# 0. Leer species_order exportado previamente
species_order <- read.csv(
  file.path(save_path, "species_order.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)[[1]]
```

# 1. Leer tabla con species + phylum

```{r}
library(readxl)
species_hv_names_tax_Porifera <- read_excel("03_Hypervolumes/06_Hipervolume_results/species_hv_names_tax.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Porifera")
head(species_hv_names_tax_Porifera)

species_hv_names_tax_Cnidaria <- read_excel("03_Hypervolumes/06_Hipervolume_results/species_hv_names_tax.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Cnidaria")
head(species_hv_names_tax_Cnidaria)
```

# 2. Leer residuos

```{r}
# 2. Leer residuos
resid_schoener <- readRDS(file.path(save_path, "mantel_residuals_schoener.rds"))
resid_jaccard <- readRDS(file.path(save_path, "/mantel_residuals_jaccard.rds"))
```

# 3. Convertir residuos a matriz

```{r}
# 3. Convertir residuos a matriz
resid_mat <- as.matrix(resid_schoener$residuals)
head(resid_mat)

#asignar species_order
rownames(resid_mat) <- species_order
colnames(resid_mat) <- species_order

resid_mat <- (resid_mat + t(resid_mat)) / 2
diag(resid_mat) <- 0
```

# PORIFERA

## Leer df largo de matriz genética Porifera

```{r}
genetic_long <- read_excel(
  file.path(phylo_dir, "Porifera_Distance_Matrix_COI_MEGA.xlsx"),
  sheet = "MatrixOutput"
)

head(genetic_long)
names(genetic_long)
```

## Preparar tabla código COI -> especie

```{r}
norm <- function(x) enc2utf8(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x)))

coi_map <- species_hv_names_tax_Porifera %>%
  filter(COI == "Yes", !is.na(COI_ID)) %>%
  mutate(
    species = norm(species),
    COI_ID = norm(COI_ID),
    COI_ID_dot = paste0(COI_ID, ".1")
  ) %>%
  select(species, COI_ID, COI_ID_dot)

coi_map
```

## Limpiar matriz genética larga

```{r}
genetic_long_clean <- genetic_long %>%
  rename(
    code1 = `Species 1`,
    code2 = `Species 2`,
    genetic_dist = Dist
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    code1 = norm(code1),
    code2 = norm(code2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(coi_map, by = c("code1" = "COI_ID")) %>%
  rename(sp1 = species) %>%
  left_join(coi_map, by = c("code2" = "COI_ID")) %>%
  rename(sp2 = species) %>%
  select(sp1, sp2, genetic_dist)
```


```{r}
genetic_long_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(sp1) | is.na(sp2))
```

```{r}
length(unique(genetic_long_clean$sp1))
length(unique(genetic_long_clean$sp2))
```

```{r}
length(unique(c(genetic_long_clean$sp1, genetic_long_clean$sp2)))

sort(unique(c(genetic_long_clean$sp1, genetic_long_clean$sp2)))
```

## Crear matriz genética simétrica

```{r}
gen_species <- sort(unique(c(genetic_long_clean$sp1, genetic_long_clean$sp2)))

gen_mat <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(gen_species),
  ncol = length(gen_species),
  dimnames = list(gen_species, gen_species)
)

for(i in seq_len(nrow(genetic_long_clean))) {
  s1 <- genetic_long_clean$sp1[i]
  s2 <- genetic_long_clean$sp2[i]
  d  <- genetic_long_clean$genetic_dist[i]
  
  gen_mat[s1, s2] <- d
  gen_mat[s2, s1] <- d
}

diag(gen_mat) <- 0

gen_mat[1:5, 1:5]
```

## Función simple para convertir residuos a matriz con nombres

```{r}
make_resid_mat <- function(resid_obj, species_order) {
  mat <- as.matrix(resid_obj$residuals)
  rownames(mat) <- species_order
  colnames(mat) <- species_order
  mat <- (mat + t(mat)) / 2
  diag(mat) <- 0
  mat
}
```

## Crear matrices de residuos con nombres

```{r}
resid_schoener_mat <- make_resid_mat(resid_schoener, species_order)
resid_jaccard_mat  <- make_resid_mat(resid_jaccard, species_order)

head(resid_schoener_mat)
```

## Alinear residuos con especies Porifera con COI

```{r}
species_common_schoener <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(resid_schoener_mat),
  rownames(gen_mat),
  colnames(gen_mat)
))

species_common_jaccard <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(resid_jaccard_mat),
  rownames(gen_mat),
  colnames(gen_mat)
))

length(species_common_schoener)
species_common_schoener
```


## Subset final

```{r}
resid_schoener_pori <- resid_schoener_mat[species_common_schoener, species_common_schoener]
resid_jaccard_pori  <- resid_jaccard_mat[species_common_jaccard, species_common_jaccard]

gen_pori_schoener <- gen_mat[species_common_schoener, species_common_schoener]
gen_pori_jaccard  <- gen_mat[species_common_jaccard, species_common_jaccard]
```


## Mantel: residuos vs distancia genética

```{r}
mantel_resid_gen_schoener <- mantel(
  as.dist(resid_schoener_pori),
  as.dist(gen_pori_schoener),
  permutations = 999,
  method = "pearson"
)

mantel_resid_gen_jaccard <- mantel(
  as.dist(resid_jaccard_pori),
  as.dist(gen_pori_jaccard),
  permutations = 999,
  method = "pearson"
)

mantel_resid_gen_schoener
mantel_resid_gen_jaccard
```


## Guardar matrices y resultados

```{r}
saveRDS(gen_mat, file.path(phylo_dir, "porifera_COI_genetic_distance_matrix_species_names.rds"))
saveRDS(resid_schoener_pori, file.path(save_path, "resid_schoener_porifera_COI.rds"))
saveRDS(resid_jaccard_pori, file.path(save_path, "resid_jaccard_porifera_COI.rds"))

write.csv(gen_mat, file.path(phylo_dir, "porifera_COI_genetic_distance_matrix_species_names.csv"))

mantel_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("Schoener residuals", "Jaccard residuals"),
  mantel_r = c(
    unname(mantel_resid_gen_schoener$statistic),
    unname(mantel_resid_gen_jaccard$statistic)
  ),
  p_value = c(
    mantel_resid_gen_schoener$signif,
    mantel_resid_gen_jaccard$signif
  ),
  n_species = c(
    length(species_common_schoener),
    length(species_common_jaccard)
  )
)

write.csv(
  mantel_summary,
  file.path(save_path, "mantel_residuals_vs_COI_genetic_distance_porifera.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

mantel_summary
```


## PLOTS

```{r}
# preparar datos (solo triángulo superior)
get_upper <- function(mat) mat[upper.tri(mat)]

df_plot_schoener <- data.frame(
  schoener_resid = get_upper(resid_schoener_pori),
  genetic = get_upper(gen_pori_schoener)
)

plot_phylo_schoener <- ggplot(df_plot_schoener, aes(x = genetic, y = schoener_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2, shape = 16, color = "#80cdc1") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
            color = "#018571",
            fill = "grey80",   # ← cambia el gris
            alpha = 0.4,
            linewidth = 1)+
  labs(
    title = "Phylogenetic effects on residual co-occurrence (Schoener)",
    x = "Genetic distance (COI)",
    y = "Residual co-occurrence (Schoener)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

plot_phylo_schoener
```

```{R}
ggsave(
  file.path(local, "06_Figures/plot_phylo_residuals_schoener.png"),
  plot = plot_phylo_schoener,
  width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600
)
```
